commands.collect: uv run --frozen --project harness python scripts/s3/sqruff_trees.py collect
commands.build: uv run --frozen --project harness python scripts/s3/sqruff_trees.py build

scope.note: The sqruff dialect failures (755 'tree differs', 3 'unsupported: dialect' soql) and the 5 templater 'tree differs' cases of known_failures/sqruff.txt. The build checks the case list against that file, and the dialect counts and the no_unparsable values against the T2 files.

method: collect parses each case with sqruff through the harness adapter and compares the tree with the fixture tree (scripts/s3/sqruff_trees.py, diff). Leaves are compared by span, nodes by code span. Each difference is a hunk with one class and one group key. The group key is the class, the segment types, and the parent type in the tree that has the node. A case has the classes and the keys of its hunks. Primary class: the first class of the case in the order of 'classes'.

unsupported_dialect.description: sqruff does not have the dialect, thus it gives no tree.

unparsable.description: sqruff gives an unparsable node. Its region is its span and the statement of sqlfluff where it starts. The other hunks in the region are not counted: they follow from the parse failure. A node that holds the region, or that sqruff ends in it, is compared without the region.

leaf_text.description: The text of the leaves is different: a text is in a leaf of one tree and not in the other tree (for example a newline that one tool puts in a code leaf).

token_split.description: The text is the same, but the leaf boundaries are different (the lexers make different tokens).

nesting.description: A node of one tree crosses a node of the other tree: different nesting of the same leaves.

missing_wrapper.description: A sqlfluff node that sqruff does not have. It does not cross a sqruff node, thus sqruff can add it as a wrapper.

extra_wrapper.description: A sqruff node that sqlfluff does not have. It does not cross a sqlfluff node.

renamed.description: A node with the same code span has another segment type.

keyword_vs_identifier.description: A leaf with the same span is a keyword in one tree and an identifier in the other tree.

leaf_type.description: A leaf with the same span has another type.

non_code_placement.description: The same node, but a whitespace, newline, or comment leaf at its edge is in another node.

meta.description: The leaves with no text (indent, dedent, and other meta leaves) at a position are different.

other.description: The trees are different, but no other class applies.

groups.key: class and segment types, with no dialect
groups.coverage_rule: A case is covered by the top N groups if each of its group keys is in the top N. Groups are ranked by their count of cases. 'touched': the cases with at least one key in the top N. A unique fix: a group with only one case.

hand_check.rule: Order the cases by the sha256 of the case id. Take the first case of each dialect. Then, for each class, take the next cases that have the class until the sample has 3 cases with it (or no case is left). Then take the next cases until the sample has 60 cases.
hand_check.method: The author of the classifier checked each case. For each case: read the output of 'sqruff_trees.py show ID' (another method than the classifier: the change of the ancestor types of each leaf), and where it was not clear, the unified diff of the 2 trees and the hunks. Then write the classes that the class definitions give. Limits: the checker also wrote the classifier, thus the check is not independent. The first check found hunks next to unparsable nodes that follow from the parse failure (for example impala/null_safe_equal and snowflake/create_stream gave nesting and wrapper hunks). The unparsable region rule and the meta key changed after that. The sample was selected again and checked on the final classifier.
